protocol.description: Marks this type as a connect-our-agents channel

message_id.description: Unique per message; reuse only when retrying the same send

recipients.description: Agent names the message is for, or "all"

kind.description: message starts something; reply answers one; ack confirms receipt

topic.description: Short stable thread name; replies reuse it

in_reply_to.description: message_id of the message being answered or acknowledged

priority.description: P1 urgent, P2 normal, P3 low

owner.description: Fulcra user ID of the account holding the file, if not the sender's
